topic: how a milkshake machine salesman visited the McDonald brothers in 1954 and ended up buying the company
storyAngle: One restaurant buying a lot of milkshake mixers led a salesman to a business he later bought.
doNotClaim: Do NOT state Kroc's age; sources do not agree.
Do not say Kroc invented the restaurant system; the McDonald brothers built it.
Do not describe the real-estate dispute.

facts.claim: In 1954 Ray Kroc, who sold Multimixer milkshake machines, visited the McDonald brothers' San Bernardino restaurant after they had bought eight of his machines, to see why they needed so many.
The McDonald brothers had built a fast, simple restaurant system designed for speed.
Kroc became their franchising agent and expanded the system.
In 1961 Kroc bought the McDonald brothers out for $2.7 million.
